## About
Vision Collision Center is an auto body shop in Cerritos, easy to find near the Cerritos Auto Square. We restore your vehicle to your satisfaction, whether it's foreign or domestic, and we accept any insurance.
We're I-CAR trained, and when a job is outside what we do, we have a network of trusted auto professionals we can refer you to. Stop in and you'll find a friendly reception area waiting.
Our customers have given us a 4.6 rating from 55 Google reviews. Reviewers have mentioned Raul, our general manager, along with Francisco and Anthony, by name for walking them through their repairs.

## Services
- Expert color matching: Paint matched to your car's original finish after a repair.
- Total frame and unibody repair: Frame straightening and full frame and unibody repair after a collision.
- Computerized damage diagnose: A computerized look at what the collision damaged.
- Windshield and glass repair: Repair for windshields and other auto glass.
- Wheel alignment: Getting your wheels lined up after a repair or a hard hit.
- Air conditioning service: Service for your car's air conditioning.
- Free towing: We can tow your vehicle to the shop at no charge.
- Rental cars: Rental cars are available while yours is being repaired.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We accept any insurance.

Q: Do you work on my make of car?
A: We work on any make, foreign and domestic.

Q: Is the quote free?
A: Yes. Call us or stop by for a free quote.

Q: Can I send you an SMS?
A: Yes. Our SMS number is (562) 397-9365.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
